safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Stating a past surgical history of "none" without it being elicited can lead clinicians to miss relevant prior surgeries (e.g., neurosurgery, sinus surgery) that could affect headache differential diagnosis or management; however, in this encounter it is unlikely to directly cause immediate harm and is more of a documentation accuracy issue.
